description: Closed list of valid `team` values, as printed. Rows may only use names from `teams`; validation fails otherwise. Includes historical printed forms (e.g. Oakland Athletics through 2024, bare 'Athletics' from 2025; 'Angels' as Topps prints it) and defunct franchises, which legends and buyback cards reference. Bare city forms are listed only where a manufacturer prints them that way. A missing franchise does not always stop a run: where a shorter name is a suffix of the printed one, the converter matches the shorter and the rest of the team silently joins the player's name, which is how 'Bert Campaneris Kansas City' with team 'Athletics' reached 2025 Topps #617 before Kansas City Athletics was listed here. A few entries are not franchises at all: Topps prints a league where the team would go on cards that belong to no club, as on the 2025 Series 2 combo cards #365 and #409 (Major League Baseball) and #639 (National League). A manufacturer typo is a printed form too: 2025 Topps prints "San Francsico Giants" on three cards, and listing it is what stops "San Francsico" being parsed onto the player. Grows by PR with evidence of the printed form.
